inPath.description: InPath is the path to a YAML file containing Kubernetes manifests. The file may contain multiple documents separated by '---'. One of the documents must be a StringReplacer resource (kind: StringReplacer) whose replacements map drives the string substitutions.

outPath.description: OutPath is the path to write the resulting YAML after replacements have been applied. The StringReplacer resource is excluded from the output.
